name: vwap_mean_reversion_basic_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, moderate intraday deviations of 0.10-0.20% below (or above) session VWAP — roughly 24-48 spot points at 24000 — that coincide with a 5-second bar volume surge (exceeding 1.5x the 20-minute average) mark the climax of retail stop-sweep and short-duration algo momentum flow, not institutional directional conviction. VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks who have been patiently waiting at this deviation level then begin aggressive accumulation, since every fill at -0.12% from VWAP gives them meaningful benchmark outperformance. RSI(24) reading between 25-40 (a 2-minute exhaustion window) confirms momentum is fading but not yet spent — the institutional absorption has begun but the spot price hasn't fully turned. Two consecutive rising 5-second bars (close[t] > close[t-1] > close[t-2]) provide microstructure confirmation that the retail sell wave has been absorbed and NIFTY's directional pressure has flipped, enabling entry at the inflection point rather than chasing the reversion after it accelerates.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session day
indicators.purpose: Session-cumulative VWAP from 09:15 open — no scaling needed. VWAP is anchored to the session start and accumulates regardless of bar frequency; it represents the fair-value benchmark every institutional VWAP-execution algo targets.

indicators.name: vwap_dev_pct
indicators.purpose: Percentage deviation from VWAP — no scaling. Entry threshold tuned from 0.6% (equity stocks) down to 0.10-0.20% for NIFTY index, since the index is far less volatile than individual stocks. A 0.12% default (28 spot pts) puts us in the moderate-deviation zone where VWAP gravity is reliably active but deviations occur 5-10 times per session, not just on extreme risk-off days.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: RSI over 24 bars = 2 minutes at 5s resolution. Original used RSI(14) on 1-minute bars (14 minutes). We compress to 2-minute RSI (24 bars) because we are trading the FAST reversal — the 15-90 second bounce — not the full mean reversion that takes 15-60 minutes. A 2-minute RSI at 35/65 detects the moderate exhaustion threshold where institutional absorption has begun, earlier than extreme readings (< 15/> 85) which signal that the move has already fully burned out.

indicators.name: volume_ratio_240
indicators.purpose: Current bar volume divided by 20-minute (240 bars × 5s) rolling mean volume. Baseline of 240 bars matches the original's SMA(volume, 20) on 1-minute bars — both measure the same 20-minute look-back window. A ratio > 1.5 identifies the volume spike that marks retail/algo climax flow, distinguishing it from quiet mean-drift deviations that don't generate reliable snapback dynamics.

indicators.name: two_bar_momentum
indicators.formula: close[t] > close[t-1] AND close[t-1] > close[t-2] (bull) | close[t] < close[t-1] AND close[t-1] < close[t-2] (bear)
indicators.purpose: Preserved directly from original — two consecutive 5-second bars in the reversal direction. At 5s resolution on NIFTY this represents 10 seconds of confirmed directional momentum after the volume-surge deviation, providing microstructure evidence that the retail climax flow has been absorbed and buyers/sellers have taken control. At 1-minute resolution this same pattern required waiting 2 minutes; at 5s we get the same structural signal in 10 seconds.

conditions: two consecutive rising 5-second bars: close[t] > close[t-1] > close[t-2]
buy_ce.confirmation: Two consecutive green 5-second bars after volume-surge VWAP deviation with RSI moderately oversold

conditions: two consecutive falling 5-second bars: close[t] < close[t-1] < close[t-2]
buy_pe.confirmation: Two consecutive red 5-second bars after volume-surge VWAP deviation with RSI moderately overbought

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option points (~6 spot points at delta 0.5): after two-bar confirmation of reversal, if NIFTY retraces 6 spot points against the trade within the first 30 seconds, the institutional absorption thesis is wrong and the volume-surge was continuation rather than climax. A 6-spot adverse move is roughly 25% of the 24-spot deviation that triggered entry — a failure threshold consistent with the typical 3-7 pt option move range for 1-minute NIFTY holds.
exit.target_rationale: 5 option points (~10 spot points at delta 0.5): a 0.12% VWAP deviation typically reverts 40-60% within 30-90 seconds when confirmed by volume surge — that's 10-29 spot points of snapback. We target the conservative lower end (10 spot pts = 5 option pts) to capture the initial institutional absorption burst, giving a 1:1.67 risk-reward ratio at the 3-pt stop.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:30 IST (no new entries after 14:30)

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 22 — original's VIX < 22 filter preserved. At VIX > 22, VWAP gravity weakens because institutional VWAP mandates may be suspended and directional conviction overrides benchmarking behavior; VWAP deviations become continuation rather than mean-reverting.
filters.time_filter: 09:30-14:30 IST — original avoided first 15 min (pre-open noise, gap fills) and after 14:30 (illiquid pre-close). For 5s bars: 09:30 start skips the first 15 minutes of volatile price discovery; 14:30 cutoff avoids the final-hour EOD positioning window where VWAP gravity fails.
filters.volume_filter: volume_ratio_240 > 1.5 — screens for genuine climax flow versus quiet drift deviations
filters.trend_filter: none — pure reversion strategy; VWAP deviation is the trend proxy
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — VWAP reversion is well-known but the volume-surge + two-bar combination provides selectivity that generic VWAP strategies lack. Edge at risk if volume data quality degrades on index or if retail participation shifts to derivatives from cash.

adaptation_notes: Converted from NIFTY200 equity universe to NIFTY index. Three key adaptations: (1) VWAP deviation threshold reduced from 0.6% (equity stocks) to 0.12% default — index is 5-8x less volatile than individual constituents; 0.12% on NIFTY equals ~28 pts, a meaningful but frequent enough deviation. (2) RSI lookback compressed from RSI(14) on 1-min bars (14 minutes) to RSI(24) on 5s bars (2 minutes) — we're targeting the FAST 30-90 second reversion, not the 15-60 minute slow drift recovery the original tracked. The moderate threshold (35/65) is preserved, distinguishing this from overshoot_fade variants which use extreme thresholds (15/85). (3) Volume ratio lookback kept at the same 20-minute window (240 bars × 5s = original's SMA(volume, 20) on 1-min). Two-bar momentum confirmation pattern preserved directly from original — at 5s resolution this 10-second confirmation filter adds microstructure validation unique among all existing VWAP strategies in this pipeline.
weaknesses: NIFTY index volume data may be noisy or have irregular spikes due to futures roll/expiry mechanics — volume ratio threshold may need per-session calibration
In strong trending sessions (>1% NIFTY intraday move), two-bar confirmation and volume surge may fire at continuation moves mistaken for reversals
RSI at 2-minute resolution (24 bars) can be erratic during rapid 5-second choppy tape — may generate false signals in sideways range-bound conditions with occasional spikes
Moderate RSI threshold (35/65) generates more signals than extreme versions, requiring strict session time filter to avoid overtrading

_source.original_stop: 1.5 * ATR(14) or 0.5% from entry, whichever tighter
